'''2007 Georgia State Championship Steven Lewis LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steven Lewis]] at [[2007 Georgia State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
